# Profiler CLI contract capture

`rank_0/kernel_details.csv` is copied unchanged from the shared profiler's
`tests/fixtures/profiler_core/rank_0/kernel_details.csv` at commit
`065b382d3bd0d39890fc8379798331ce059a65b4` (Git blob
`d3f978f29c1681a43dae1dfb610f0fc765f00a83`).

The adapter contract runs the locked, installed profiler CLI against these
existing format rows. It does not infer device performance from this fixture.
